subject: Consolidating sales engagement tooling — Salesloft renewal + migration plan
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@salesloft.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating sales engagement tooling — Salesloft renewal + migration plan

Alex —

Thanks for the quick connect yesterday. We are coming up on our renewal window for Salesloft (existing seat-based contract) and the leadership team is evaluating a consolidation of our engagement stack (Salesloft + Outreach + HubSpot cadence sync). Before the renewal auto-renews, we need: a clear renewal quote, an outline of migration/enablement for consolidating sequences, and any available credits for committing to a 12–24 month reserved seat agreement.

High-level asks:
- Current renewal quote (line-item seats + seats we can float) — please attach.
- Migration SOW for historical cadence and activity sync (we have 3M engagement events stored in HubSpot).
- Pricing for a dedicated onboarding specialist + two enablement training sessions.

Can you get a draft quote and SOW to us by EOD Tuesday (7/21)? Monica, Dylan, Neha — looping you for procurement, SDR enablement, and GTM cost modeling.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@salesloft.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating sales engagement tooling — Salesloft renewal + migration plan

Rachel —

Appreciate the summary. I attached a preliminary renewal quote (Salesloft_renewal_quote_2026-07-18.pdf) and a draft migration SOW (SOW_migration_plan_draft.docx). Quick notes:
- We can offer a 12-month committed pricing with a 10% credit on list if you convert all Outreach sequences into Salesloft templates and consolidate.
- Onboarding specialist (2 weeks dedicated) + two 90-minute enablement sessions = line-item in the SOW.
- Historical activity import: we recommend staged ingestion (90-day active window + archival) to keep the initial sync under your token limits.

I can adjust the quote to reflect an enterprise reserved-seat commitment; give me target headcount and expected start date and I’ll produce the committed pricing.

Best,
Alex Porter
Strategic Accounts — Salesloft
Attachment: Salesloft_renewal_quote_2026-07-18.pdf; SOW_migration_plan_draft.docx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@salesloft.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Consolidating sales engagement tooling — Salesloft renewal + migration plan

Jordan / ACME procurement team —

Forwarding the renewal materials from Salesloft. ACME is on our partner program and we need a procurement confirmation on the process for routing the purchase order vs DocuSign for multi-entity billing. Can you confirm whether we need an MSA amendment for the new ingestion clause (historical activity import)?

Key points for your review:
- Salesloft proposes 10% credit for 12-month commitment if we consolidate Outreach sequences.
- There is an onboarding SOW and an estimated 2-week specialist engagement.
- We will retain historical activity in HubSpot for archival but need Salesloft to accept a staged import plan.

Jordan — can you confirm PO process timelines? We are targeting contracting complete by 7/28 to avoid auto-renew kick-in.

Thanks,
Rachel

- SLA language for sequencing/step delivery latency.
- Clear acceptance criteria for the migration specialist engagement.

Monica — if procurement can confirm PO timeline, we should be able to approve the SOW and sign the renewal by next Tuesday.

All —

Procurement (Jordan) confirmed via separate thread that PO vs DocuSign routing depends on the presence of an MSA amendment. Jordan indicated legal will accept an amendment rather than a full MSA rewrite; procurement can issue a PO once amendment countersignatures are in place.

Alex — please update the SOW with: the data retention/export clause, SLA for sequencing, and acceptance criteria Dylan listed. If you can provide the revised SOW and a redline by EOD 7/22, I’ll fast-track PO issuance and route to legal for countersignature.

Happy to approve the committed pricing once the language is clarified.
